common: Photorealistic character sheet for a historical documentary reconstruction (Jerusalem, Second Temple period, about 30 CE). Real-looking living people photographed in a studio with soft neutral daylight, NOT illustrations, NOT cartoons, NOT 3D renders. No text, no labels, no captions, no numbers, no watermark anywhere. The background is one flat, perfectly uniform, pure bright green (#00FF00) with no shadows, no floor, no gradient and no green in the clothing, so it can be keyed out. Arrange the people in a clean grid with wide empty green gaps between them so that no person touches or overlaps another or the image edge; every person is shown COMPLETELY from the top of the head to the soles of the feet, in the same scale, standing relaxed and upright, arms down at the sides or hands naturally folded. Everyone is dressed very modestly and historically: coarse undyed or natural-dyed wool and linen, simple sandals, no modern items, no crosses or religious symbols of other faiths. The head and ears are covered by a headcloth or cap in every case (no loose hair around the ears, no sidelocks). Varied ages, builds, heights, skin tones of the Eastern Mediterranean and faces; realistic skin texture, weathered hands.
